title: S09T03 - Run comparative reliability and context-continuity benchmarks
description: Compare plain Markdown, at least one graph tracker, and Boreal on session resume, blocked-work selection, parallel coordination, false closeout, decision tracing, merge conflicts, and recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmark fixtures, scoring, raw outputs, environment, limitations, and reproduction commands are public and do not privilege Boreal through unequal setup.
Results report time, commands, prompt/context volume, invalid actions, false closes, conflicts, and recovery duration without overstating causality.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
